title: libredb-studio
descript: One browser tab for PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, Couchbase, ClickHouse, Druid, DuckDB, Turso and more. An open-source SQL IDE with SSO, audit trail and AI-assisted queries MIT licensed, with nothing held back behind an enterprise wall. Packaged for TerraMaster TOS 7: the official Docker Hub image runs as a container on your NAS, keeps its data in the application data folder (so it survives restarts and updates), and is opened from its desktop icon.
important: First run: open the web UI and complete the initial setup. Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/libredbstudiodocker/ and survives restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 1000, so mounted folders must be readable by that user. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the application data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

zh-cn.descript: 多数据库 Web 客户端，支持查询与结构浏览。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/libredbstudiodocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
